protocol: Final integrated estimator vs exact pre-round2 baseline (healthy gain0.90 already present); original timestamps; permitted C/F/R inputs in receive order; evaluator GNSS only; table30618/physics30639. All output comparisons use same stamps and reference masks. This is final integration evidence, distinct from train-selected isolated candidates.

public.protocol: post-freeze diagnostic; original timestamps, nearest fused signed-x reference within 50ms; common mask; no parameter choice

synthetic.protocol: Independent analytic ground truth; fixed faults; 20 Hz commands, 10 Hz wheels delayed 40 ms with deterministic noise/jitter; 5 s warmup. Fault timestamps are measurement time. Same input bytes and exact common output times for both versions.
limitations: Synthetic faults do not measure prevalence or contest robustness score.
Smooth common bias and frozen wheels at constant actual speed may be unobservable.
Reported distance is relative to the first scored output at 5 seconds.
First-5s recovery errors may include model errors beyond a fault boundary.
